items.title: Crypto casino Duelbits goes offline after $7 million hot wallet hack
items.body: Attackers drained Duelbits' hot wallets across four blockchains; about $6 million in stolen funds now sits in a single Ethereum address.

items.title: Cathie Wood's ARK teams with Securitize to tokenize venture fund with OpenAI, Anthropic stakes
items.body: The ARK Venture Fund is bringing exposure to sought-after private tech companies onchain through Securitize, first on Ethereum then potentially expanding to other chains.

items.title: Trueo prediction market moves from Base to Ethereum
items.body: Trueo said Base was the right choice when it launched, as Ethereum gas fees were higher, but said mainnet now offers greater integration potential.

items.title: Ethereum Institutional signals support for Ethlabs’ motion to reduce Ethereum block times
items.body: The non-profit signaled support for reducing Ethereum block times, citing increasing institutional activity moving onto the smart-contract network.

items.title: Ethereum, Base wallet standards talks fail, Ethlabs researcher says
items.body: Ethereum and Base are pursuing different account abstraction designs after talks failed, according to Ethlabs researcher Derek Chiang.

items.title: Bitmine projects $334M in annual staking revenue from $15.8B crypto treasury
items.body: Bitmine now has more than 5 million ETH staked, turning most of its Ether holdings into a recurring income stream as it continues to accumulate.
